paragraphs.text: The Slickshot Gang , or simply Slickshots , is a gang of outlaws on Thunder Junction .

The Slickshot Gang is a band of outlaws and thunderslingers for hire led by the crime boss Lilah . They pride themselves on being the best shots and quickest drawers on the plane, and encourage loyalty among themselves, although they often tend to work alone. They are meant to have each other's backs when trouble arises, and a transgression against one of them might as well be a transgression against all of them.

Although they have no strict uniform, Slickshots tend to wear reds, blues and purples. They do everything with style, and their clothing tends to emphasize their style, including elaborate fanned coat flaps and collars. For them, every duel is an opportunity for pageantry, and every con is a shot at fame. Wherever they go, they'll be sure to make it the ride of a lifetime.
